title: exagium: one queue after the whole-project audit (2026-11-17)
intro: Built from six skill-group audits (A security, B tests/bugs/state, C structure, D claims, E agents/free compute, F ML/binaries), a separate verification pass (S2: 15 of 16 high-impact items confirmed by reproduction, 1 partly right), and the 2026-11-13 audit and handoffs. Severity is after S2 corrections. Source of truth: queue.json; render with render.py.

items.next: Disable the bench3/5 crons first (Q20). Then, before any new bench run: build the diff without the agent .git, or run git inside the no-network container; bench-3/5 are registered, so amend or re-register; retire bench2 (Q48).
